name: Liang Siqiu
source:
Father of the Liang’s, a typical scholar.
He was quite fond of his nephew-in-law Xiaoran, who had been living with his family. His rebellious daughter Wenqian concerned him a lot.
It appeared he had kept from Xiaoran something very important.
